title: Oven-Roasted English Asparagus Bubble and Squeak
description: A grassy, pillowy, lacto-vegetarian-friendly British dish featuring white asparagus, mashed potatoes, and onions, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Pound the asparagus in a mortar and pestle until it's slightly crushed.
Toss the asparagus with butter, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper, and spread it on a baking sheet.
Roast the asparagus in a 425°F oven for 12-15 minutes, or until tender and slightly browned.
Meanwhile, mix the mashed potatoes with grated cheddar cheese and milk (if using).
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the mashed potato mixture.
Press the potato mixture into a flat disk shape and let it cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the potato disk and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until the other side is golden brown.
Transfer the potato disk to a mason jar and top with the roasted asparagus.
Cover the jar with a lid and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the asparagus bubble and squeak chilled, garnished with chopped chives or scallions if desired.
